roles.A: 编排、基础合同、集成与打包 / orchestration, platform, integration and packaging
roles.B: 桌面展示与交互 / desktop presentation and interaction
roles.C: 模型、协议、流式与上下文 / models, protocols, streaming and context
roles.D: 权限、工具与原生执行 / permissions, tools and native execution
roles.E: 会话、记忆、路径与迁移 / conversations, memory, paths and migration

developmentEntrypoints.inventory: shared build configuration outside apps / apps 范围外的共享构建配置
outside apps production inventory / 不计入 apps 生产源码统计

optionalRelativeResources.reason: Absent legacy bundled skill location is retained only for identity compatibility / 旧内置技能位置可不存在，仅用于身份兼容

testAttribution.strategy: Direct static production imports and linked Compile Include resolve to implementation owners; multiple owners mean shared review / 直接静态生产导入和链接源码引用映射到实现负责人，多角色表示共同审查
testAttribution.fallbackMeaning: Fixtures or integration checks without direct owned sources are coordinated by A, not automatically assigned to data / 无直接主责源码的夹具或集成检查由 A 协调，不统一归数据负责人
testAttribution.limitation: Indirect runtime calls and nested fixture ownership require suite README review / 间接运行调用及嵌套夹具归属仍需查阅套件 README

coverageNotes: Production inventory is limited to listed apps source scopes; generated outputs, dependencies and tests are excluded / 生产清单仅覆盖列出的 apps 源码范围，排除生成产物、依赖和测试
All seven implemented apps are inventoried, including the Rust resource service, desktop UI/resources/build projects and preview/mock code / 覆盖七个现有 apps，包括 Rust 资源服务、桌面 UI/资源/构建工程及预览/模拟代码
Bundled vendor UI assets are counted under B stewardship without authorizing edits to third-party source / 内置第三方 UI 资源统计为 B 的维护范围，不授权修改第三方原文

Gateway checks cover static import, export-from and literal new URL(relative, import.meta.url); dynamic import, require, computed paths, template interpolation and regex ambiguity are outside this lexical scanner / 网关检查覆盖静态导入、重导出与字面量相对资源；动态导入、require、计算路径、模板插值及正则歧义不在词法扫描范围
Role labels are local responsibility identifiers, not Git account names / 角色标记是本地职责标识，不是 Git 账号
